mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.check_id, i.product_id, i.sku_id, i.book_quantity, i.actual_quantity, i.diff_quantity, i.cost_price, i.diff_amount, i.diff_reason, i.status, i.create_time, i.update_time, pr.product_name AS productName, pr.product_code AS productCode, sk.spec_text AS specText, ai.stock AS currentStock, (ai.stock - ai.locked_stock) AS availableStock FROM shop_erp_inventory_check_item i LEFT JOIN shop_product_sku sk ON sk.id = i.sku_id AND sk.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_product pr ON pr.id = sk.product_id AND pr.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_inventory ai ON ai.sku_id = i.sku_id AND ai.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND ai.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.check_id = #{checkId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_erp_inventory_check_item SET product_id = #{q.productId}, actual_quantity = #{q.actualQuantity}, diff_quantity = #{q.diffQuantity}, diff_amount = #{q.diffAmount}, diff_reason = #{q.diffReason}, status = #{q.status}, update_by = #{q.updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), is_deleted = 0 WHERE check_id = #{q.checkId} AND sku_id = #{q.skuId}
